description.en: Add a website record for the team. Pass a name; optional URL and type (undefined|shop). Slug is generated automatically.
description.de: Fügt einen Website-Eintrag für das Team hinzu. Name angeben; optional URL und Typ (undefined|shop). Der Slug wird automatisch erzeugt.

warp.bot: Add a website with team + name. Optional url and type. type=shop requires url and marks this site as the post-checkout storefront return URL (one shop per team; brandless records only). Omit type or pass type=undefined for a normal website/portfolio record. Do not pass slug — it is generated from the name. metricsSource selects the reporting provider (google_search_console or cloudflare). Pass analyticsDomains together with it to enable native analytics at the same time; JoAi generates the private site key. Pass metricsSource=analytics for an analytics-only site. For Cloudflare and Google Search Console, pass metricsResource as the zone tag or property URL. monthlyReport=true opts into the 1st-of-month report job (does not send now). If a reporting source returns channel_not_configured, call settings-integration-open with its integration, then retry. Use site-provision when the site should be live on a Warp brand.

warp.name: JoAi: Update Site

description.en: Update a site’s enabled state, name, URL, custom domain, type (undefined|shop), contact, metrics source/resource, monthly report schedule, uptime monitoring, uptime check path or content slug.
description.de: Aktualisiert Aktivierung, Name, URL, eigene Domain, Typ (undefined|shop), Kontakt, Metrik-Quelle/-Ressource, Monatsbericht, Uptime-Monitoring, Uptime-Prüfpfad oder Content-Slug einer Website.

warp.bot: Update site fields including optional type and custom domain. customDomain sets the site’s own bare hostname (e.g. example.com, no protocol) and must be unique across teams. type=shop requires url, only works on brandless sites, and marks this site as the post-checkout storefront return URL (one shop per team). Pass type=undefined (or empty) to clear shop. metricsSource selects the reporting provider (google_search_console or cloudflare) and preserves native analytics. analyticsDomains adds or updates native analytics alongside the reporting provider; JoAi generates the site key when needed. Pass analyticsDomains=[] to disable native analytics. metricsSource=analytics is accepted as a shorthand for enabling analytics. For Cloudflare and Google Search Console, pass metricsResource as the zone tag or property URL. monthlyReport=true opts into the 1st-of-month job when contact and metrics are set — it does not send immediately. uptime=true enables uptime monitoring with a public status page; it requires url or custom domain and a paid plan (free plans return 402). If a reporting source returns channel_not_configured, call settings-integration-open with its integration, then retry. uptimePath sets the path the monitor checks on the site URL (e.g. /health); pass an empty string to clear it. content is the public content slug (e.g. my-content-slug) and requires the site to have a brand.

en.question: How do I connect a custom domain to a site?
